body.message:
Could you please provide us with an update at your earliest convenience, as we need to adjust the booking accordingly within the next hour.

If we didn't receive the update, your check-in date may need to be calculated from today.

Therefore, kindly confirm as soon as possible whether you will be proceeding with the security deposit payment or if you would like us to amend the booking dates to start from tomorrow.

Thank you for your prompt attention and cooperation.
